item.title: Federal Judge Dismisses Most Claims Against Law Enforcement Officers in Lawsuit Over Cannabis Raid on Tribal Land
item.description: A federal judge last week tossed most of the claims against two California sheriffs and the California Highway Patrol (CHP) in a lawsuit claiming deputies illegally raided tribal land, Courthouse News reports.
